patthana8.68:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca na rūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana8.68:2.1: na na rūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na rūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana8.68:3.1: na rūpāvacaraṃ ca na na rūpāvacaraṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca na rūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati, hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
